Accessibility Conformance Report (ACR) — VPAT® 2.5 Revised Section 508 & WCAG 2.2 Level AA

Product Documentation Package: RaggieSoft Help Studio (raggiesoft.help-studio v0.5.0)

Publisher: RaggieSoft • Compiler: RaggieSoft Help Studio v0.5.0 (Static /MT Win32 C++20)

Evaluated Deliverables: Native Windows 11 x64 & ARM64 RaggieSoftHelp.exe Offline F1 Viewer + Pre-Rendered HTML5 Web Documentation Portal (4 topics, 4 F1 Context IDs).

WCAG 2.2 Level A & AA + Revised Section 508 Chapter 5 & Chapter 6 Evaluation
CriterionConformance LevelRemarks and Technical Verification
1.1.1 Non-text Content (A)SupportsCompile-time gate RSH020 enforces non-empty alt attributes across all topic figures; legacy CHM/HLP importer repairs missing alt text automatically.
1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)SupportsRSH015 verifies hierarchical headings; native Win32 SysTreeView32, SysListView32, and RichEdit 4.1 expose full UI Automation roles.
1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA)SupportsBody copy achieves ≥15.8:1 contrast in Dark Mode (#F8FAFC on #0D1426) and ≥16.1:1 in Light Mode (#0F172A on #FFFFFF); RSH025 scrubs legacy Word MsoNormal black-on-black inline styles; RSH055 enforces ≥4.5:1 brand accents.
1.4.11 Non-text Contrast & High Contrast (AA)SupportsAutomatic SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST detection switches RaggieSoftHelp.exe and HelpStudio.exe immediately to pure OS system colors (Aquatic, Desert, Dusk, Night Sky).
2.1.1 Keyboard & F1 Context Routing (A)Supports100% keyboard navigable with Alt+Key mnemonics, visible focus indicators, and sub-5ms Named Pipe F1 context-ID navigation without keyboard traps.
Revised Section 508 §602 Support DocumentationSupportsDelivers both zero-dependency air-gapped Windows offline documentation (free of IE mshtml.dll and UNC Mark-of-the-Web blocks) and semantic HTML5 web documentation.
